mintAuthority.summary: USDX is the native Kava usdx bank denom, issued by x/cdp against posted collateral. Global and collateral debt ceilings are governed and raiseable, not unconditional raw-mint powers. The Stability Committee and stake governance can change CDP parameters; governance and the Safety Committee can schedule validator-adopted software upgrades. These controls bind only kava:usdx; the separate Osmosis ICS-20 receipt remains under Bridge Risk.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14/A7 review on 2026-10-03 at kava block 22858316 (0x0a53ef4b48a349e92eb13de6bfb32ac0ff19649fea0e2e9b5889a754123d1dd8): an ABCI Query/Params read returned code 0 at the exact height, and the archive RPC block hash agrees with the LCD block pin. Node information reports Kava 0.28.2 / source commit 686d591443a1de7c5566bc7d92faf5b56743f25f. That source's x/cdp Keeper.AddCdp validates collateral, owner balance, debt limit and collateralization, then transfers collateral into the module before MintCoins; AddPrincipal rechecks collateralization against existing posted collateral before minting additional USDX to the owner. Raising GlobalDebtLimit or per-collateral limits only increases capacity of those same checked routes and does not confer a bank raw-mint permission. Collateral/oracle parameter admission and validator-adopted software upgrades are not standalone D14 triggers. Retain raiseable with raiseable-collateral-only proof; no non-EVM D29 certificate is expressible or authored.

The existing October-3 raiseable-collateral-only source review is retained with its original date. Control targets now name only native kava:usdx; the catalog identity limitation and external-only-representation exception are retired. The known legacy market discount is not relabelled a mint-authority compromise. These reads establish controls, not whole-book reserve reconciliation or IBC pending-message conservation.
